title: prenanthes altissima f. hispidula
intro: Prenanthes altissima f. hispidula, commonly known as Tall White Lettuce or White Snakeroot, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including reducing fever and relieving pain, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antiseptic actions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents found in Prenanthes altissima f. hispidula include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
